TourFAQ1.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our tour packages, booking process, payments and more. If you still have questions, feel free to reach out to our support team.

items.question: How do I book a tour package?
items.answer: You can book a tour package directly through our website by selecting your preferred destination, travel dates and package. Submit an enquiry with your details, and our travel experts will confirm availability and guide you through the booking process.

items.question: What is included in the tour package?
items.answer: Each package lists clear inclusions such as flights, hotels, transfers, sightseeing and meals where applicable. Always review the inclusions and exclusions on the package detail page, or ask our team for a full breakdown before booking.

items.question: Can I customize my tour package?
items.answer: Yes. Most of our packages can be customized — from hotels and activities to travel dates and itinerary pace. Share your preferences in the enquiry form and we will create a tailored plan for you.

items.question: What are the payment methods?
items.answer: We accept UPI, net banking, major credit and debit cards, and bank transfers. For selected packages, we also offer flexible installment plans. Full payment details are shared at the time of confirmation.

items.question: Is travel insurance included?
items.answer: Travel insurance is usually optional unless mentioned in the package inclusions. We can help you choose suitable coverage based on your destination, trip duration and traveler needs.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Cancellation terms vary by package and supplier. In general, earlier cancellations receive higher refunds. Exact refund timelines and charges are mentioned in your booking confirmation and on our Cancellation Policy page.

items.question: Do you provide visa assistance?
items.answer: Yes. We provide visa assistance for popular destinations. Document checklists and processing timelines are shared after you confirm your trip so you can prepare everything on time.

items.question: How can I contact your support team?
items.answer: You can reach us by phone, email or through the Contact Us page. Our support team is available to help with bookings, itinerary changes and on-trip assistance whenever you need us.

itinerary.title: Water Activities

itinerary.title: Leisure & Relaxation
itinerary.description: Spend a day at leisure. Enjoy your resort amenities, spa, or simply relax by the beach and soak in the beauty of the Maldives.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from the resort and transfer to Male Airport for your onward journey with wonderful memories.

items.title: Switzerland Highlights
items.description: Explore breathtaking landscapes, charming towns and alpine adventures.
items.about: Explore Switzerland's alpine landscapes, charming towns, and scenic railways. This highlights itinerary blends mountain views, lakeside walks, and iconic Swiss experiences for an unforgettable European escape.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich
itinerary.description: Arrive in Zurich, meet your representative, and transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure to explore the old town.

itinerary.title: Lucerne & Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Travel to Lucerne and enjoy a guided orientation of the chapel bridge and lake. Optional Mt. Titlis excursion.

itinerary.title: Interlaken & Lakes
itinerary.description: Continue to Interlaken. Enjoy panoramic views of the Jungfrau region and free time by the lakes.

itinerary.title: Jungfrau Region
itinerary.description: Take in alpine villages, waterfalls, and optional mountain excursions in the Jungfrau region.

itinerary.title: Bernese Oberland
itinerary.description: Discover charming mountain towns and scenic viewpoints with time for photos and local cafes.

itinerary.title: Geneva / Montreux
itinerary.description: Travel westward for lakeside views, chateaus, and a relaxed evening in a Swiss city.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your return flight with alpine memories.

items.title: Thailand Explorer
items.description: Stunning beaches, vibrant culture and amazing food await you.
items.about: Discover Thailand's beaches, temples, and street food culture on a well-paced family-friendly itinerary. From Bangkok's energy to coastal relaxation, this package balances sightseeing with easy downtime.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bangkok and transfer to your hotel. Evening stroll at a local market if time permits.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Highlights
itinerary.description: Visit iconic temples, the grand palace area, and enjoy a guided city orientation.

itinerary.title: Fly to the Coast
itinerary.description: Take a domestic transfer to the beach destination and check in to your coastal hotel.

itinerary.title: Island Day
itinerary.description: Cruise to nearby islands for swimming, snorkeling, and beach time.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day for spa, shopping, or optional activities.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

items.description: Modern attractions, luxury shopping and desert adventures.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai
itinerary.description: Arrive in Dubai, transfer to your hotel, and enjoy a relaxed evening at the marina or downtown.

itinerary.title: City Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Dubai's signature landmarks, photo stops, and a guided city orientation.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Afternoon desert safari with dune bashing, cultural entertainment, and dinner at camp.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Shopping

itinerary.title: Departure
